title: lomatium martindalei
intro: Lomatium martindalei, commonly known as Mountain Biscuitroot, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Lomatium martindalei include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes, such as martindaleol, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
